changes.title: Legend floor
items: Each sleeping legend's circle has a floor of old, cracked flagstones with its sigil carved in, mostly lost under moss and grass
Each circle's floor takes its area's character: its own stone, debris from its ground cover, moss or lichen, puddles where it's wet
Legend circles now lie level on the hills, with no ponds or campfires in them

changes.title: Slow time look
items: In a sleeping legend's circle, as time slows outside, the world beyond the circle turns grey and cold, its smoke, sparks and motes hang in the air, and the circle's edge shimmers
A 💌 that leaves a slowed circle vanishes in a little sparkle at its edge

changes.title: Beach
items: A secret for explorers: fly to the very edge of the world and you'll find a beach, with the calm dark sea mirroring the moon and stars and the sound of waves
Keep flying out to sea and she lands on the sand and lies back to look at the stars
Now and then other witches are hanging out on the beach: land near them and you'll chat, hold hands, hug and stargaze together
